description: We are Team ASTERIA: three 12–13-year-old innovators from Dubai, UAE, and proud NASA Space Apps Global Alumni 2025. Skilled in Python, Java, AI, and Machine Learning, we blend creativity, curiosity, and teamwork to turn bold ideas into tech-driven solutions. ASTERIA (Astronomical SPHEREx Time-series Extraction & Rapid Image Analysis) helps anyone spot comets, asteroids, and new worlds moving across the sky. Explore ASTERIA and watch the sky move. 🌌
